title: A healing consumable (dried herbs/dried peas) can be selected via 'use X' and is consumed even at full HP with only flavor text ('Bitter, but they ease the ache.') and zero effect; because the numbered menu shifts every turn as items are gained/lost, it's easy to hit the wrong 'use' entry by accident and waste it, which happened to me reaching for 'use king's seal.'
